{{Icon|Heat Amp icon|'''Heat Amp'''}} is a type of buff applied to operators in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When operators are affected by '''Heat Amp''', they temporarily deal more {{Color|Heat DMG|3}}. The number represents the degree of increase.

Multiple sources of Heat Amp, as well as {{G|Arts Amp}} stack <u>additively</u> to form the '''Amp Multiplier''' for that damage instance. The resulting Amp Mulitplier stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with other damage multipliers to get the final value. For more information on calculating damage, see [[Damage calculation]].
